updates.note: Management reiterated EBITDA margin guidance of around 30% to 31% for FY27.
updates.quote: And the EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.

updates.note: Management guided for double-digit revenue growth in the range of 10% to 12% for FY27.
updates.quote: Yes, it will be in the range of 10% to 12% minimum.

updates.note: Inauguration of third production line at HAL Nashik was completed on 17th October 2025.
updates.quote: Production capacity of 8 LCA Mark-1A per annum established with the inauguration of the third production line at HAL Nashik
And the EBITDA margin, we have always maintained around 30%, 31%, and it will be maintained.

updates.note: Only 6 engines received from GE by the time of call reporting.
updates.quote: As you are aware, that we have 6 engines received from GE now

updates.note: Mark II prototype rollout pushed to last quarter of the year (March).
updates.quote: So we are expecting in the last quarter of this year, for the rollout of Mark II.
Production capacity of 8 LCA Mark-1A per annum established with the inauguration of the third production line at HAL Nashik

new_promises.statement: Invest around INR 12,000 crores in manufacturing infrastructure projects by 2030.
new_promises.quote: We plan to invest around INR12,000 crores in these projects by 2030.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Kota

new_promises.statement: Receive orders of INR 90,000 crores, including ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
new_promises.quote: In total, we expect to receive orders of INR90,000 crores, including the ROH orders, during the next 2 years.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Kota

new_promises.statement: Roll out Tejas Mark II prototype by March of current financial year.
new_promises.quote: So we are expecting that by March, we should be able to roll out Mark II.
new_promises.speaker: Ravi Kota
